declienting: Ported the imperative showToast(messageHtml, { variant, dismissMs }) utility to a declarative React <Toast> that portals to document.body with consumer-controlled open; the messageHtml innerHTML sink became a children: ReactNode slot, which removes the XSS surface.
Replaced the inline SVG status-icon markup with an inline currentColor icon per variant; the library ships no Icon component yet.

Mapped toast.css surface/text classes onto library semantic tokens: surface color-surface-raised, text color-text-primary, and the critical variant color-tone-critical — a new tone token added to src/tokens/semantic.css, since the library had no tone layer; plus border color-border-subtle, box radius-medium, elevation shadow-overlay, the bottom offset spacing-l, and inline padding spacing-s / spacing-2xs.

Drove the entrance animation through the --animate-fade-in / --duration-base tokens, so the reduced-motion media query is the single switch that collapses it, rather than a bespoke component keyframe.

Kept verbatim: the role/aria-live pairing per variant (neutral → status/polite, critical → alert/assertive) and the auto-dismiss timing — the live-region contract. Kept deliberately distinct from Alert rather than merged.
